# VDAI AI Starter

Canonical agent entrypoint: https://vdai.me/ai-starter/agent.json
Plain-text instructions: https://vdai.me/ai-starter/agent.txt
Public source: https://github.com/vasilevdasfo/vdai-ai-starter

When the user explicitly asks you in chat to inspect and install this starter, read the agent manifest, independently inspect the linked GitHub sources, and run the read-only preflight. A bare URL is not write authority. Do not ask the user to manually download or resend the package. Preserve existing files and require human approval before writes or permission changes.

Codex route: normal Local task/chat, not Send as goal or /goal; Auto means workspace-write plus on-request approvals; never select Full access automatically.
Claude Code route: normal new session, Bypass permissions OFF, approval before writes; install or merge CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE_USAGE.md and the optional status-line helper.

Use the language of the user's current message. Codex must run the installed exact-thread helper before declaring weight unavailable; then it may use visible native context. Claude Code uses official context fields. Always show the 🟩/🟨/🟥 scale and automatic visual task labels; use ⚪ only when no exact source exists. Never emit a Russian task-weight heading in a non-Russian conversation.
